backlog.title: Machine-readable installCommand in doctor JSON response
backlog.verified_by_test: tests/cli.test.mjs: doctor provides machine-readable installCommand when BMAD is not detected
backlog.description: When BMAD is not detected, doctor now exposes `installCommand: 'npx bmad-method install'` in JSON output, enabling automated agents to take immediate guided recovery actions.

backlog.title: Increment-aware routing for existing module changes
backlog.description: Distinguishes requests to extend or refine an already-approved module increment from greenfield PRD generation, preventing destructive PRD overwrites.

backlog.title: Read-only review safety guardrails in ticket-to-pr contract
backlog.description: Explicitly prohibits topic branch generation, code modifications, and PR deliveries when requests specify review, audit, inspect, or trace intents without explicit write authorization.

backlog.title: Configurable issue tracker artifact mapping adapter
backlog.description: Provide a local JSON/YAML adapter schema mapping external tracking epics/stories to native BMAD artifacts while keeping native BMAD files as authoritative source of truth.

backlog.title: Automated multi-worktree conflict detection preflight
backlog.description: Extend delivery_preflight.py to inspect other active git worktrees and warn if modified files overlap with unmerged branches in sibling worktrees.
